entries.title: Psalms 140:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man; {violent...: Heb. man of violences}

entries.title: Psalms 140:2
segments: Which imagine mischiefs in [their] heart; continually are they gathered together [for] war.

entries.title: Psalms 140:3
segments: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison [is] under their lips. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 140:4
segments: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

entries.title: Psalms 140:5
segments: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 140:6
segments: I said unto the LORD, Thou [art] my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 140:7
segments: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 140:8
segments: ¶Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; [lest] they exalt themselves. Selah. {lest...: or, let them not be exalted}

words.text: . {lest...: or, let them not be exalted}

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
segments: [As for] the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

words.text: of those that compass me about

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
segments: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

words.text: upon them: let them be cast
, that they rise not up again

entries.title: Psalms 140:11
segments: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow [him]. {an...: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow}

words.text: [him]. {an...: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow}

entries.title: Psalms 140:12
segments: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, [and] the right of the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13
segments: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
